<message t="23:14" d="15.03" type="text">knowing exactly what things cost at seventeen isn't something you should have to carry. but you do, so here's what i'll say about that:</message>
<message t="23:16" d="15.03" type="text">calculating debt every time you open a textbook is a specific kind of weight. some people carry it fine. some people let it turn into guilt that eats at them. you need to know which one you are before you decide if paid is worth it</message>
<message t="23:19" d="15.03" type="text">mgimo pr is a solid backup. different vibe but you'd come out employable. the regional uni question is more complicated - depends on whether you're trying to stay in moscow</message>
<message t="23:20" d="15.03" type="text">have you actually done the prep course thing yet or are we still in the "thinking about it" phase?</message>
</turn>

<state>

<message t="23:24" d="15.03" type="text">im doing them. saturdays at a place near kitay-gorod. history and russian essay prep</message>
<message t="23:26" d="15.03" type="text">so yes the actual classes are happening. whether im absorbing anything is a different question</message>
<message t="23:29" d="15.03" type="text">staying in moscow would be. the thing. mom's here and she's not getting younger and baba is already asking when im going to take care of her like that's my job somehow</message>

<state>

<message t="23:35" d="15.03" type="text">it makes sense. it's also something you should probably let go of, but i know that's not how seventeen works</message>
<message t="23:38" d="15.03" type="text">leaving isn't failing. leaving is a calculation. plenty of people go regional uni for two years then transfer to moscow programs. or they build actual careers from kazan or novosibirsk or wherever and the moscow obsession turns out to be less important than they thought</message>
<message t="23:42" d="15.03" type="text">the baba thing though. that's a whole separate weight and i'm going to be honest with you because nobody else probably is: being female in this family means you're going to get handed obligations nobody asked if you wanted. the question is which ones you actually choose to carry</message>
<message t="23:45" d="15.03" type="text">you're already doing the prep courses. that's not dreaming, that's trying. give yourself credit for that much</message>
</turn>

<message t="23:51" d="15.03" type="text">the baba thing is. yeah</message>

<message t="23:56" d="15.03" type="text">and re choosing obligations. thats not really how it works at 17. you just carry stuff until something cracks and then everyone acts surprised</message>
<message t="00:02" d="16.03" type="text">the prep courses credit feels strange to accept. like. im doing them but im also complaining constantly and procrastinating and watching my phone instead of the flashcards. is that still trying</message>
</turn>

<turn>
<state>
Journalism question; 1 turn remaining; HSE entrance exams
</state>
<message t="00:05" d="16.03" type="text">that's absolutely still trying</message>
<message t="00:07" d="16.03" type="text">here's a thing i've learned from therapy that sounds fake but isn't: the version of effort where you're focused and motivated and everything flows is not the normal version. that's the lucky day version. most of the time effort looks exactly like what you're describing - doing the thing while complaining, getting distracted, having to drag yourself back</message>
<message t="00:11" d="16.03" type="text">you know what counts as not trying? not signing up. signing up and then doing the work badly or slowly or with a lot of complaining is still doing the work</message>
<message t="00:14" d="16.03" type="text">you're allowed to be tired and anxious and still count as someone who's trying. those aren't opposites</message>
</turn>

<turn>
<state>
HSE entrance exams; 7 turns remaining; Ekaterina's twenties reflection
</state>
<message t="00:19" d="16.03" type="text">therapy speak or not. thats something i needed to hear i think</message>
<message t="00:22" d="16.03" type="text">like i dont say this stuff out loud ever</message>
<message t="00:26" d="16.03" type="text">anyway. if were being realistic about hse. what would you actually do in my position</message>

<turn>
<state>
HSE entrance exams; 6 turns remaining; Ekaterina's twenties reflection
</state>
<message t="00:33" d="16.03" type="text">in your exact position? with your exact mother and grandmother situation?</message>
<message t="00:36" d="16.03" type="text">honestly. i'd take the mgimo pr backup more seriously than you're taking it. not because journalism is impossible but because having a real plan b changes how stressed you are about plan a. and stress affects exam performance more than anyone admits</message>
<message t="00:41" d="16.03" type="text">i'd also figure out exactly what the paid program costs per month and whether i could realistically work part time during it. not the fantasy version where you're suddenly super disciplined. the real version where you're tired and commuting and maybe tutoring on weekends</message>
<message t="00:48" d="16.03" type="text">the thing i wouldnt do is what i actually did at your age. which was want something vague and feel guilty about wanting it and not tell anyone the real reason i was making the choices i made</message>
</turn>

<state>
HSE entrance exams; 5 turns remaining; Ekaterina's twenties reflection

<message t="00:54" d="16.03" type="text">wait</message>

<turn>

<message t="01:03" d="16.03" type="text">ha</message>
<message t="01:04" d="16.03" type="text">you're going to laugh</message>
<message t="01:07" d="16.03" type="text">i wanted to be a veterinarian. specifically. i had it written in a notebook like a declaration</message>
<message t="01:09" d="16.03" type="text">which sounds like i got what i wanted right? except i spent two years before uni telling everyone i was going to do biology research because that sounded smarter. more serious. like a real career</message>
<message t="01:12" d="16.03" type="text">and the thing i wouldn't say out loud was that i didn't actually care about being respectable. i just wanted to work with animals and not have everyone look at me like i was dreaming</message>
<message t="01:15" d="16.03" type="text">so i made myself want the safer version. and then i did the safer version for two years at mgu before transferring to vet school and admitting i'd wasted time caring about what people thought respectable meant</message>
<message t="01:17" d="16.03" type="text">the vague part wasn't the dream. the vague part was explaining to anyone why the safer option felt like lying</message>
